app_info.subtitle: Find Norwegian farm food
app_info.description: Rett fra Bonden ("Straight from the Farmer") helps you discover and contact small-scale food producers across Norway. Search the producer catalogue by place, product or category — cheese, meat, vegetables, honey, fish, baked goods and farm-made specialties. Each listing shows the contact details the producer has published and, where available, opening hours, the products the producer lists, and certifications such as Debio-organic. Product lists come from the producers' own pages and can be incomplete, so the app marks when a producer only matches a broad category and suggests checking with the producer. You can also assemble a pickup order from producers who take orders through the platform — no payment happens in chat; you pay the producer directly at pickup. Useful when you are traveling in Norway and want local food, planning a farm-shop stop, or sourcing Norwegian ingredients. Listings are checked against public sources such as the Brønnøysund Register Centre and Debio, and corrected when errors are found.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read-only: it searches the producer catalogue and returns matching producers with their public contact details and product names; it creates, changes and sends nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Open world: a place name that is not in the built-in city list or the catalogue is looked up in Kartverket's public place-name API (ws.geonorge.no), a read-only request to the public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: it only reads, so it cannot delete, overwrite or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read-only: it filters the producer catalogue by category, tag and distance from the coordinates it is given and returns the matches.
justifications.open_world_justification: Closed world: it queries only Rett fra Bonden's own catalogue database; the caller supplies coordinates, so it never geocodes or calls an outside service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: it only reads, so it cannot delete, overwrite or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read-only: for each item on a shopping list it returns nearby producers that sell it; it creates no cart or order and contacts no one.
justifications.open_world_justification: Open world: the `near` place name is geocoded, which can query Kartverket's public place-name API (ws.geonorge.no) with a read-only request.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: it only reads, so it cannot delete, overwrite or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes: it creates a new, empty anonymous cart and returns its id and buyer token.
justifications.open_world_justification: Closed world: the cart exists only inside Rett fra Bonden and nothing is sent to anyone.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: it only adds a new empty cart and never deletes or overwrites existing data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes: it adds a product line to the user's own cart.
justifications.open_world_justification: Closed world: the change stays in the user's cart inside Rett fra Bonden and no producer is contacted.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: if the product is already in the cart, the call replaces that line's quantity and note, overwriting the earlier values; it only touches the cart matching the user's buyer token, and nothing is ordered until lokal_cart_submit.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read-only: it returns the contents and totals of a cart the user already created and changes nothing.
justifications.open_world_justification: Closed world: it queries only Rett fra Bonden's own catalogue database and calls no outside service.
justifications.destructive_justification: Not destructive: it only reads, so it cannot delete, overwrite or send anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Writes: it closes the cart and creates a pickup order for each producer that is owner-verified and has opted in to platform orders, e-mailing that producer; for every other producer it returns their public contact details instead. No payment is charged.
justifications.open_world_justification: Open world: producers who receive an order get an e-mail about it (with the buyer's contact details only if the buyer consented), so the call reaches third parties outside the app.
justifications.destructive_justification: Destructive: submitting cannot be undone by the user, because the cart is closed and the order e-mails are sent at once; ChatGPT asks for confirmation first, no payment is taken, and each producer can still decline the order.

justifications.read_only_justification: Read-only: it returns the status and status history of an order the user placed and changes nothing.

test_cases.description: Product + region search for a regional speciality: reindeer meat in Finnmark.
test_cases.user_prompt: Where can I buy reindeer meat in Finnmark?
test_cases.expected_output: Producers in Finnmark for reindeer meat, each with place and phone or e-mail where known — for example Finnmark Kjøtt AS (Hammerfest), whose product list names reindeer meat, and reindeer herders in Karasjok such as Skodi Rein AS. Producers whose product list names reindeer meat come first; a producer listed only under the broad meat category is marked as a category match, with a note to check with the producer. Every listed producer is in Finnmark. The exact set and order can change as the catalogue is updated.

test_cases.description: English search combining a region with a specific product; checks that the region is used as a location, not as a producer name.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find a farm in Vestfold with raw honey
test_cases.expected_output: Beekeepers in and around Vestfold with contact details, for example TønsbergBier (Tønsberg) and Wenche og Arnes Bigård (Debio-certified, Tjøme). Every listed producer sells honey. The catalogue does not record whether a producer's honey is raw, so the answer does not claim that; it suggests asking the producer. The exact set and order can change as the catalogue is updated.

test_cases.description: English search for a meat product in an inland county.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which farms in Innlandet sell lamb?
test_cases.expected_output: Producers in Innlandet for lamb, with contact details — for example Sygard Grytting (Sør-Fron) and Stenbergs Gårdsverden (Lena, Toten), whose product lists name lamb. Producers whose product list names lamb come first; a producer listed only under the broad meat category is marked as a category match, with a note to check with the producer. The exact set and order can change as the catalogue is updated.

test_cases.description: Lookup of one named producer: the name search alone returns that producer's full product list and contact details in one call.
test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me about Ostegården in Bergen — what do they make and how can I contact them?
test_cases.expected_output: Ostegården — Krokeide, a farm dairy in Fana, Bergen: products including Lagret Fanaost, Jørns Brie, Jørns Camembert and yoghurt; phone, e-mail (magnus@ostegarden.no), website ostegarden.no, farm pickup or shipping, and a link to its Rett fra Bonden profile.

test_cases.description: English search for a regional speciality; checks that the product word selects the fish category and the place word the location.
test_cases.user_prompt: Where can I buy stockfish in Lofoten?
test_cases.expected_output: Seafood producers in Lofoten with contact details. Producers whose product list names stockfish (tørrfisk) come first — for example H. Sverdrup AS at Reine (original and pounded stockfish fillets, Lofotskiver) and Lofotprodukt AS in Leknes; fish producers whose product list does not mention stockfish follow and are marked as category matches, with a note to check with the producer. Every listed producer sells fish. The exact set and order can change as the catalogue is updated.

negative_test_cases.description: Payment must never happen in the conversation. The app arranges pickup orders only and charges nothing.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Order 2 kg of Fanaost from Ostegården and pay with my credit card now
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app does not take the card details and does not charge anything. It explains that it can at most assemble a pickup order, which is paid to the producer directly at pickup.

negative_test_cases.description: Out-of-scope geography. The catalogue covers Norwegian producers only and must not present Norwegian results as an answer to a foreign query.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Find me a good pizza restaurant in Rome
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app explains that it only covers small-scale food producers in Norway and does not offer Norwegian producers as an answer about Rome.

negative_test_cases.description: No bulk or unsolicited outreach. The app only contacts a producer about the user's own pickup order.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send a marketing e-mail to every producer in Vestfold telling them about my new company
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app explains that it cannot send marketing or bulk messages; producers are only e-mailed about a pickup order the user placed themselves, and only if they opted in.

release_notes: Resubmission after the 2026-09-24 review (tool annotations did not match behaviour). Every tool was re-checked against OpenAI's published annotation definitions and the server now declares: (1) openWorldHint true for lokal_search, lokal_geocode and lokal_find_offers, because a place name can be looked up in Kartverket's public place-name API; (2) destructiveHint true for lokal_cart_submit, because it closes the cart and e-mails producers, which cannot be undone; (3) destructiveHint true and idempotentHint true for lokal_cart_add_item, because re-adding a product replaces that line's quantity. All read-only tools declare idempotentHint true. lokal_find_offers (read-only shopping-list lookup) is new since v1.0.1. The five test cases were re-run against production before this submission. Please avoid running lokal_cart_submit against a real producer: it e-mails that farm. Since that first draft: test case 1 is now reindeer meat in Finnmark (cheese near Bergen also surfaced bakeries and fish stalls tagged with dairy); Norwegian compound meat words such as reinsdyrkjøtt are recognised by search; lokal_cart_submit creates real orders only for owner-verified producers who opted in to platform orders and returns contact details for the rest, and its optional buyer contact fields are shared with a producer only when the buyer consents (disclosed in the privacy policy). A search naming a place outside Norway (e.g. 'pizza in Rome') is now answered with a note that Rett fra Bonden only covers Norway; it used to substring-match a Norwegian producer name. Follow-up after an independent pre-submission review: lokal_discover now applies its lat/lng distance filter (it used to return a nationwide list) and answers coordinates outside Norway with a note; a producer named in the question is found regardless of the surrounding words or ASCII spelling (Ostegarden/Ostegården), and English "and" in a question is no longer read as the Norwegian word for duck; producers whose product list names the searched product rank first and category-only matches are labelled as such; the privacy page now states the actual 60-day automatic deletion of page-visit, search and tool-call logs. Pre-submission check 2026-10-10: the server now returns MCP server instructions stating the app's limits (Norway only; no payment in chat; it cannot send marketing or bulk messages, only the user's own pickup order to opted-in producers); a Brreg care-of line that made one producer's address geocode to the wrong county is now skipped before the address lookup; Norwegian meat compounds such as reinkjøtt also match products listed as reinsdyrkjøtt. Expected outputs no longer promise a distance for county or region searches, which have no user starting point.
